newsitem.title: USA: ABN AMRO to merge unit's trust subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO to merge unit's trust subsidiary.

text.p: ABN AMRO Holding NV's ABN AMRO North America Inc, parent of LaSalle National Corp, said Monday its trust subsidiary will merge with its largest commercial bank.
Effective January 2, 1997, it plans to merge LaSalle National Trust, with $21.7 billion in assets under administration, into LaSalle National Bank. The transaction is subject to regulatory approval.
Harrison Tempest, chairman of ABN AMRO North America, also said James Wynsma, president of LaSalle National Trust, will become a vice chairman and director of LaSalle National Bank.

As part of the merger, a new wealth management unit will be formed to include private banking, trust investment portfolio management, trust administration, trust sales staff and the high net worth brokerage unit of ABN AMRO Investment Services.
A search is under way to find the new head for this unit who will report to Wynsma.
